messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month really depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, activities, or price—but most travelers find that late spring (April–May) or early fall (September–October) offer a sweet spot:

| Season | Typical Weather | Crowds | Activities |
|--------|-----------------|--------|------------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | Cooler (~70 °F/21 °C), higher chance of rain, especially on the windward side | Peak holiday season – crowded, higher prices | Great for whale watching (Oct–Jan), lower rates outside holidays |
| **Spring (Mar–Jun)** | Warm (~75–80 °F/24–27 °C), drier, sunny | Low‑to‑mid season – fewer tourists, moderate prices | Ideal for hiking, snorkeling, beach days |
| **Summer (Jul–Aug)** | Hot (~85 °F/29 °C), very dry, occasional afternoon showers | High season – crowded, higher prices | Perfect for water sports, festivals, family vacations |
| **Fall (Sep–Nov)** | Warm (~80 °F/27 °C), drier than winter, less humidity | Shoulder season – fewer crowds, good deals | Excellent surf conditions, great for outdoor adventures |

If you’re after the lowest prices and don’t mind a bit more rain, consider visiting in **late October** or **early November**. If you prefer the classic tropical vibe with plenty of sunshine and don’t mind paying a little extra, **July** or **August** will deliver that. For a balance of pleasant weather, fewer crowds, and reasonable rates, **April, May, September, or October** are usually the top picks.
